answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 44 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The marble schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the basalt checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 11 effective identities must lock that capital for 44 epochs and keep it locked through every river audit. That is 37 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
